title: Add JSON Schema Request Body Validation Middleware
description: Introduce a lightweight middleware that validates incoming request bodies against a user‑provided JSON schema. This eliminates repetitive validation code, improves security, and returns standardized 400 errors for malformed payloads.
testCases: Valid request body matching schema returns next() and proceeds to handler
Invalid request body returns 400 with detailed validation errors
Missing schema argument throws a descriptive developer error
acceptance: The middleware can be attached to any route via router.use(validateBody(schema)). When the payload conforms to the schema the request proceeds; otherwise the response is a JSON 400 error containing an array of validation messages. The middleware does not interfere with existing routing, static file serving, or other middleware and logs validation failures at debug level.
reason: Developers frequently need request payload validation, currently done manually in each handler. Providing a built‑in, zero‑dependency solution reduces boilerplate, prevents malformed data from reaching business logic, and aligns yantraverse with production‑grade security practices.
